Hi, I’m Nithila!

With over four years of experience in the tech & consulting, I’ve evolved from a software developer to a product owner, merging my technical skills with a strong business mindset. I’ve worked on global projects like corporate websites and DevOps tools, and my journey has taught me how to bridge the gap between what users need and what businesses require.

I’m passionate about driving product success by crafting clear roadmaps, prioritizing the right features, and ensuring seamless collaboration between stakeholders and teams. With an MBA from IIM Kozhikode and a B.Tech. in Computer Science, I’m here to make things happen—innovative, impactful,and on-point.

From concept to execution, driving results and not just output!
